title: Session Identity Binding Response
description: GET /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/identity-binding (content identity M3 PR-5-lite). Success envelope (response_handler.success_response): {success, message, data} where data is SessionIdentityBindingResponseV1 -- TraigentBackend src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py get_session_identity_binding, serialized by src/services/content_identity/run_binding.py RunIdentityBindingService.read (_run_binding_json / _trial_binding_json / _stored_members). Returns exactly what the Backend STORED when the session and its trials sent content_identity: record_state is 'draft' in Release 1 (RunIdentityBindingRowV1.record_state / TrialIdentityBindingRowV1 carry no completion state of their own yet). No identity rule is evaluated here -- this is a read of stored facts, never a verdict. NOT the same shape as execution/run_identity_binding_v1_schema.json's RunIdentityBindingV1: that is the future normalized, certificate-oriented record (agent/dataset/evaluator/trials assembled from server-witnessed facts); this is the raw run_identity_bindings / trial_identity_bindings ROW as stored today, columns and all (rejection_reason, declared, facts, agent_key, ...). The Row* names here are deliberately distinct so the two are never confused. Declared ahead of Backend parity tests: x-asserted-against-backend false on the catalog operation until TraigentBackend feat/content-identity-run-binding lands on develop.

RunIdentityBindingRejectionReasonV1.description: Closed vocabulary of why the declared content_identity block was not accepted as evidence (TraigentBackend src/services/content_identity/run_binding.py REASON_*). A rejection never fails the run: the binding is still stored, as record_state draft. content_identity_too_large: the declared block exceeded the server's byte cap and was discarded (declared is null). content_identity_not_an_object: the value was not a JSON object (declared is null). wire_schema_invalid: the value was an object but failed SessionContentIdentityWireV1 / TrialContentIdentityWireV1 (declared is still stored, raw). wire_schema_unavailable: the wire contract itself could not be loaded server-side; fails closed to draft rather than 5xx.

MemberListWireV1.description: One SERVER-STORED member list a binding points at, recomputed on every load (ContentIdentityMemberListStore.load / RunIdentityBindingService._stored_members). members are MultisetMemberV1, in canonical order (sorted by (example_id, example_version)), so a consumer can recompute root from server data alone without trusting root, distinct_count or total_count on their own.

root.description: dataset_root on the run binding, or evaluated_root on a trial binding -- always equal to the root of the binding this list is served from.

members_source.description: Provenance of the stored list itself (ContentIdentityMemberList.members_source): server_computed when the Backend minted it (e.g. from a hosted dataset version), client_submitted when it was accepted from a declared block whose stated root the server verified.

provenance.description: Always server_recorded: this whole object is the server's own read of a stored row, never a copy of what a client sent.

MemberListLoadErrorV1.description: The rare case where the stored member list a binding points at no longer recomputes or cannot be found (ContentIdentityMemberList integrity failure, or the row is gone). RunIdentityBindingService._stored_members never serves a partial or unverified member list; this narrower shape is what is served instead. status is a stable code (an exception's .code, or its class name when it has none) but its exact closed vocabulary is NOT pinned by this contract yet -- x-asserted-against-backend is false for the whole operation, and this branch in particular has no Backend test coverage as of M3 PR-5-lite.

status.x-content-note: INV-GAP S9: not inventoried (free string): status
status.description: Stable failure code, e.g. MemberListNotFound, or an integrity-error reason. Never a raw exception message.

MemberListOrUnservedV1.description: null when the binding has no stored member list yet (no dataset_member_list_id / evaluated_member_list_id); the full MemberListWireV1 on the normal path; MemberListLoadErrorV1 only if the stored list fails to load (see that definition).

RunIdentityBindingRowV1.description: run_identity_bindings row (TraigentBackend src/models/run_identity_binding.py RunIdentityBinding), as served by _run_binding_json plus the resolved dataset_members. Every key is always present; most are nullable, reflecting the draft-by-default, append-only, one-row-per-run contract.

key_id.description: Null until a schema-valid content_identity block names a key_id (draft bindings created from an invalid/oversized/absent block never set it).

record_state.description: Always 'draft' in Release 1: 'complete' needs the Director-captured base_head_generation (Release 2).

agent_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free
agent_id.description: The resolved, server-owned agent row id. Null when the declared agent id is a fallback label (no registered build) or the agent slot is unavailable/rejected.

agent_key.description: The declared agent identity key the base_build_digest was recomputed against, whether or not it resolved to a registered agent row.

base_build_digest.description: Server-RECOMPUTED digest of the base agent build manifest. Never trusted from the client's declared value alone; equal to it only because the server recomputed and it matched.

base_head_generation.description: Server-captured Director head-table generation at run creation (Director W3). Always null in Release 1 -- nothing captures it yet.

dataset_root.description: The server's own recomputed multiset root of the bound dataset. Null whenever the dataset slot was withheld, refused (e.g. unregistered key_id, root mismatch) or absent.

dataset_version_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free
dataset_version_id.description: The ONE hosted dataset version whose server-computed root equals dataset_root, when exactly one exists. Null when the dataset is not hosted, no version resolves, or more than one candidate is ambiguous (see facts.dataset.dataset_version).

facts.description: The server's own, versioned account of what it established (facts.version is FACTS_VERSION). Every sub-fact is labelled provenance 'server_recorded' or 'declared'; the label is computed server-side and never copied from the client. Open-ended and evolving with the binder (key_id, agent, dataset, evaluator, base_head_generation, record_state, wire, and, on a trial, trial_id/evaluated/trial_origin) -- not itself a closed contract yet.

declared.description: The client's raw content_identity block, kept verbatim up to the server's size cap -- a DECLARATION, never evidence. Null when the value was too large to keep, was not a JSON object, or no content_identity was sent. NOT guaranteed to match SessionContentIdentityWireV1: a value that failed wire-schema validation (rejection_reason wire_schema_invalid) is still stored here exactly as sent.

completed_at.description: Always null in Release 1 (record_state never reaches 'complete' yet).

TrialIdentityBindingRowV1.description: trial_identity_bindings row (TraigentBackend src/models/run_identity_binding.py TrialIdentityBinding), as served by _trial_binding_json plus the resolved evaluated_members. One row per configuration run (trial) whose submitted result carried metadata.content_identity under an already-bound run.

trial_origin.description: server_issued: the trial id came from POST .../next-trial. client_submitted: a client-sequenced trial (trial_sequencing='client').

observed_provider_versions.description: Recorded verbatim from the declared block's observed_provider_versions once it validates; [] otherwise (never absent).

session_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free

trials.description: Ordered by (created_at, configuration_run_id). Empty when the run has a binding but no trial has sent content_identity yet.

x-backend-obligations: A session/trial whose content_identity failed validation is still stored as a draft binding with rejection_reason set; identity problems never fail the run.

dataset_members / evaluated_members are the server's OWN reload of the stored list, recomputed on every read; a consumer MUST recompute root from members rather than trust root, distinct_count or total_count on their own.
declared is the client's raw block and MUST NOT be treated as verified: only facts (provenance server_recorded) and the top-level server columns are the server's own account.
The read never evaluates or returns an identity RULE verdict; it is a stored-facts read only.
